tldr: 台積電走弱、台股 8/6 收黑，但伺服器導軌廠川湖股價攻上萬元，成為台股史上第 3 檔「萬金股」。
南亞科董事會將 2026 年資本支出上調 34% 至 697 億元，加速 5A 新廠建置，四年總投資達 3466 億元。
金融三業上半年大賺 9042 億元、年增 139% 創同期新高，全年獲利有望挑戰歷史紀錄。

items.title_zh: 台積電拉低台股 千金股撐盤
items.title_en: TSMC drags TAIEX lower as thousand-dollar stocks shine
items.summary_zh: 台積電 8/6 收跌 40 元，拖累加權指數收盤下挫 214 點，多頭於高檔震盪整理。惟盤面「千金股」表現亮眼，抵銷權值股弱勢，顯示資金在高位轉倉輪動、而非全面撤離，短線指數維持高檔震盪格局。
items.summary_en: TSMC closed down NT$40 on Aug 6, pulling the TAIEX 214 points lower in choppy, high-level consolidation. Even so, high-priced "thousand-dollar" names outperformed, keeping index heavyweights supported and signalling that funds are rotating rather than fleeing the market outright.

items.title_zh: 外資縮手小買 20 億 川湖攻上萬元
items.title_en: Foreign buying shrinks to NT$2bn as Chenbro tops NT$10,000
items.summary_zh: 外資 8/6 對台股由前日買超 903 億大幅縮手至小買 20 億元，加碼力積電等電子股、同時大砍金融股。伺服器導軌廠川湖（2059）在業績題材撐腰下股價攻抵萬元、創歷史新高，成為台股史上第 3 檔「萬金股」，反映資金向利基題材集中。
items.summary_en: Foreign investors bought a net NT$2.0bn of Taiwan shares on Aug 6, sharply down from NT$90.3bn the prior day, adding chip names such as PSMC while dumping financials. Server-rail maker Chenbro (2059) broke above NT$10,000 to become the market's third-ever quadruple-digit stock on strong earnings momentum.

items.title_zh: 南亞科上調資本支出 34% 至 697 億衝刺 5A 新廠
items.title_en: Nanya lifts 2026 capex 34% to NT$69.7bn for 5A fab
items.summary_zh: 南亞科董事會 8/5 決議將 2026 年資本支出上限由 520 億元上調至 697 億元、增幅 34%，加速 5A 新廠建置。5A 新廠四年資本支出上限達 3466 億元，導入 10 奈米級 EUV 製程，目標 2029 年月投片 35,900 片，反映其押注 AI 帶動的記憶體上升循環。
items.summary_en: Nanya Technology's board on Aug 5 raised its 2026 capex ceiling to NT$69.7bn from NT$52bn, a 34% jump, to accelerate its 5A DRAM plant. The wider 5A project carries a NT$346.6bn four-year budget targeting 35,900 wafers/month by 2029 using 10nm-class EUV nodes — a decisive bet on the AI-driven memory upcycle.

items.title_zh: CoWoS 產能 2026 年底估增 67% 先進封裝供應鏈受惠
items.title_en: CoWoS capacity to grow ~67% by end-2026 on AI packaging demand
items.summary_zh: 台積電 CoWoS 先進封裝月產能預估由 2025 年底約 7～7.5 萬片，成長至 2026 年底 10～10.5 萬片、年增約 67%。因 CoWoS-L 等外包比重約五成，日月光投控等封測廠可望受惠；業界焦點亦轉向以高壓直流與面板級封裝解決 AI 晶片的電力與散熱瓶頸。
items.summary_en: TSMC's CoWoS advanced-packaging capacity is projected to rise from about 70,000–75,000 wafers/month at end-2025 to 100,000–105,000 by end-2026, roughly a 67% gain. With CoWoS-L outsourcing running near 50%, OSAT players such as ASE stand to benefit as the industry pivots to solving power and thermal limits in AI chips.

items.title_zh: 金融三業上半年大賺 9042 億 創同期新高
items.title_en: Financial trio earns record NT$904.2bn in H1 2026
items.summary_zh: 銀行、保險、證券期貨三業 2026 年上半年合計獲利 9042.45 億元、年增 139%，創歷年同期新高。其中銀行業稅前盈餘 4002.2 億元、保險業 3094 億元同創同期新高。獲利動能強勁，全年有望挑戰歷史紀錄，並支撐金融股評價與股利發放預期。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's banks, insurers and securities/futures firms earned a combined NT$904.2bn in the first half of 2026, up 139% year on year and a record for the period. Banks alone posted pre-tax profit of NT$400.2bn and insurers NT$309.4bn, both first-half records, leaving the full-year result on course to challenge an all-time high.

items.title_zh: 金管會推利變保單資訊揭露新制 防當定存
items.title_en: FSC tightens disclosure on interest-sensitive insurance policies
items.summary_zh: 金管會針對利率變動型保險商品推出資訊揭露新制，避免保戶將利變保單誤當定存、引發銷售爭議。新制要求業者於銷售時更清楚揭露報酬與風險資訊，強化保戶保護並提升儲蓄型保單市場品質，對壽險通路銷售行為將形成規範。
items.summary_en: The FSC is rolling out new disclosure rules for interest-sensitive (利變型) insurance products to stop consumers treating them like time deposits and to curb mis-selling disputes. Insurers must present return and risk information more clearly at the point of sale, a move aimed at protecting policyholders and improving the quality of the fast-growing savings-type policy market.

items.title_zh: 亞洲資產管理中心 AUM 提前達標 高資產成成長引擎
items.title_en: Taiwan's asset-management hub push hits AUM target early
items.summary_zh: 依產業回顧，政府 2024 年啟動的亞洲資產管理中心政策下，台灣資產管理規模已於 2025 年底提前達成兩年政策目標。高資產財富管理是推升市場規模的核心引擎，主管機關透過法規鬆綁與程序簡化，加速台灣邁向區域資產管理樞紐，帶動私銀與信託業務商機。
items.summary_en: Under the government's Asia Asset Management Centre policy launched in 2024, Taiwan's assets under management reached its two-year policy target ahead of schedule by end-2025, according to industry reviews. High-net-worth wealth management remains the key growth engine, with regulators easing rules and simplifying procedures to position Taiwan as a regional asset-management hub.
items.source_name: KPMG 台灣財富管理報告

items.title_zh: 高股息與市值型 ETF 續居 2026 存股族最愛
items.title_en: Dividend and market ETFs dominate 2026 retail favourites
items.summary_zh: 0050、00919、00878 等高股息與市值型 ETF 於 2026 年持續居台灣存股族定期定額熱門榜首，配息、成分股與殖利率為主要考量。債券 ETF 仍是股債配置核心工具；投資人選擇也逐漸從純高股息，擴及市值型與主題型 ETF，反映理財需求多元化。
items.summary_en: Popular income and index ETFs such as 0050, 00919 and 00878 continue to top Taiwan retail investors' regular-savings lists in 2026, prized for their dividends, constituents and yields. Bond ETFs remain a core tool for stock-bond allocation, while savers increasingly look beyond pure high-yield names toward broader market-cap and thematic ETFs.
